resources.string: Start the server, then choose Auto Backup on the camera. Away from home, turn the hotspot on first and connect the camera to it.
Waiting for the camera: Wi-Fi → Auto Backup (or Smart Link).
Opening the hotspot settings: turn the hotspot on, then connect the camera to it. (Android lets only the system settings switch it on.)
This phone has no hotspot settings screen the app can open; turn the hotspot on from the quick settings.
Nothing received yet.\n✓ on this phone · ✓✓ on the home server
Stop the server to change these settings.
Phone only: keep photos in a folder on this phone (✓)
Phone + home server: keep them here and upload to the server whenever it is reachable (✓ → ✓✓)
Home server only: forward straight to the server, nothing stays on the phone (✓✓)
The home server speaks plain http:// on port 52235; https:// only works through a TLS reverse proxy.
Export pairing file (zip for the SD card)
Unzip into the SD card root → creates dlna_web_root/SAMSUNGAutoBackupDESC.ini. Repeat after formatting the card. Use the same UDN on the home server so one card works with both.

The camera only finds a server whose UDN is on its SD card. With a new UDN, cameras paired with the current one (%1$s) can no longer back up to this phone until you export the pairing file again and copy it to their cards.\n\nThe current UDN is kept in the history below, so you can switch back.
%1$s becomes the current UDN again. Cameras paired with the UDN you use now will stop finding this phone; the one you switch to works with the cards that still carry it.
None yet. Every UDN you replace is kept here.
Tap a previous UDN to switch back to it (cards paired with it work again).
Shared with the server %1$s: one pairing file works for both.
The server %1$s uses a different UDN (%2$s). Cards paired with one of them do not reach the other.
Asking the server for its identity…
Use the server\'s identity on this phone?

This phone will advertise the server\'s UDN %1$s and name \"%2$s\". Cards paired with the server then also work with this phone. Cards paired with this phone\'s current UDN stop working until you export the pairing file again; the current UDN stays in the history.
Give the server this phone\'s identity?

The server %1$s will switch to this phone\'s UDN %2$s and name \"%3$s\" and switch its camera side over. Cards paired with this phone then also work with the server; cards paired with the server\'s old UDN stop working with it.
Identity taken over from the server
Server switched to this phone\'s identity
Could not exchange the identity with the server (see log)
Name of this phone (shown on the server)
Where should photos from the camera go?
The list on the main screen shows ✓ when a photo is on this phone and ✓✓ when it has reached the home server.
The home server runs cambackup-server (Docker). Its status page shows the URL and the token to use here.
The camera only talks to a server whose identity is on its SD card. Give the server a name, export the pairing file and unzip it onto the card.
